goal: Test one previously untested conjunction (causal Vol40 cash-fraction size + 4pct entry stop + closed-bar +2pct gross-entry arm + original MR40 natural exit) against unchanged baseline and two existing single-component reference families; explicitly REJECT if not robust. Not a threshold sweep.

source_semantics.entry: Use only first closed 4h MR40+Momentum30 signal episode indices from frozen prior decisions, execute at next bar open; these are already-seen historical indices so economic outcome is descriptive.
source_semantics.size: Vol40 target fraction=min(1,0.4/annualized population stdev of prior 180 log close returns up to signal bar); cash* fraction; round quantity DOWN to 0.00001 BTC. No leverage and no scale-in.
source_semantics.exit_priority: Previously closed 4h natural signal at next open > adverse gap at next open > same bar low touching known stop (hypothetical fill model, not observed real fill). Stop exit blocks re-entry in same signal episode.
source_semantics.arm: Only when prior confirmed close >= entry fill*1.02, set gross fill-based entry stop effective at NEXT open. Not fee-adjusted breakeven. No retroactive stop.
source_semantics.min_notional: 1 USDT and 0.00001 BTC; original mathematical engine convention only; no real exchange execution guarantee.
source_semantics.cost: normal or stress fee/slippage per side as above. No claim that OHLC intrabar stop fill is executable.

qualification: For novel combined candidate, require on BOTH train and evaluation at 10000 AND 500 USDT: net PNL >= baseline and >= both single-component cases under BOTH normal and stress; close DD <=90% baseline AND <= both references under normal and stress; >=70% baseline winning trade count and >=70% summed winning PnL preserved, no single-trade dependence. Even if passed, still NO_PROMOTE because historical samples have been seen and 4h/1m full-OHLC parity failed.
accounting: First EXACTLY reproduce existing baseline ledger prices, fees, fills and close-equity SHA for every fixed profile and account. If failure => do not consider combination results valid.
